enacting_law: Pub. L. 93-406 (Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974)
notes: 1974 vesting schedules were significantly less favorable than today's. The 10-year cliff option allowed plans to deny all employer contributions to any worker who left before 10 years. Subsequent amendments (1986 TRA, 2001 EGTRRA) tightened the schedules to 5-year cliff / 3-7 year graded (standard) and 3-year cliff / 2-6 year graded (employer matching).
